candidate_windows.window_text: In our experiments, we use the pre-trained RoBERTa-base (Liu et al., 2019) as our Encoder. We adopt Adam (Kingma and Ba, 2015) with the learning rate of $3e - 5$ and the batch size of 256 to update the model. The maximum training epoch is set to 25 and the wait patience for early stopping is set to 10 for all models. We clip the gradient L2-norm with a threshold 2.0. For contrast learning, the weight of positive examples is set to 1.6 and the weight of negative examples is set to 1. All experiments are performed with $1\times 80\mathrm{GB}$ NVIDIA A100 GPU.
